purpose: Every place where Paper B will print a value that only measurement block 5 can supply, named before any such value exists. A slot says which artifact the value is read from, which field of it, in what unit, and where the analysis plan registers it. No slot has a value: every value is null until the release event.

synced_to.note: The registration, analysis plan and flag catalog are revision 9, DRAFT, not sealed. The test checks this manifest against them strictly while their bytes equal these digests, and reports a stale sync point (without failing) once they have moved.

alpha.name: 1.7B window
alpha.label: ALPHA
alpha.holds: for the 1.7B model, the absolute repeats and null quads of both workloads

gamma.name: contrast window
gamma.label: GAMMA
gamma.holds: for each workload, quads with the 1.7B model on side A and the 8B model on side B

forms.absolute: floor form over the kept absolute repeats
forms.comparative: floor form over the kept null-quad differences
forms.shared_sign: the comparative floor replayed with one shared sign across all kept quads (the plan's R_cm)

shapes.label: one value from a closed list of names
shapes.table: rows whose number is not known before collection; parts names the columns
shapes.line: one registered line of text with the numbers named in parts

issue.copy: copied, or conservatively rounded, from the named field (the plan's MEASURED)
issue.derive: computed from the named field by the formula the plan names in rule (the plan's DERIVE)

available.before_collection: a design parameter, known before block 5 collects
available.structure: counts, verdicts and measured hazard quantities, releasable during the block (registration section 8 item 2)
available.after_release: an energy or a quantity derived from one, readable only after the release event (registration section 8)

placement_states.RETIRED_FALLBACK: a site retired by the fallback decision, printable only after a new ruling
placement_states.PROPOSED_STOP_FILL: a proposed site whose fill is blocked until adopted
placement_states.NOT_PROPOSED: no site proposed yet (the plan's open DISCLOSURE-SITES)

basis.named: the plan names this field, an object on its path, or every flag code selected
basis.inferred: the plan names the quantity in words; this manifest inferred the field from the code, to be confirmed at the post-seal sync

frozen_identifiers.note: Cell, family and contrast identifiers used in select, with the committed file each is read from.

prefill_selection.what: The prefill-length selection record of measurement block 3: the prompt length block 5 uses.
prefill_selection.where: selection.json of the block-3 probe (registration section 0.5)

identity_pins.what: The sealed pins that fix which model files and runtime versions may be measured.

reported_energy.what: One record per reported cell: mean, interval endpoints, per-token value and the units kept.
reported_energy.where: analysis step 10 (analysis plan section 3.1); one record per cell, in analysis custody

detection_floor.what: The aggregate detection-floor artifact: one cell per model and phase, with its absolute and comparative components.
detection_floor.where: analysis step 5, the production mint (analysis plan section 3.1)

dominance_closeout.what: The close-out record: every dominance ratio with its two floors, and the branch decision.

claim_verdicts.what: The claim gate's output: for each contrast its estimate, intervals, floor, multiplicity decision, outcome and claim ceiling.
claim_verdicts.where: analysis step 9, the claim gate (analysis plan section 3.1)

exclusions.what: The exclusion function's output for one attempt: removed members, the kept and removed units of each cell, and whether the attempt is claim-usable.
exclusions.where: derived/exclusions.json in the attempt's harvest archive (analysis plan section 2.2)

harvest_record.what: The harvest's one record per attempt: its verdict and its window-removing reasons.
harvest_record.where: harvest.json in the attempt's harvest archive (registration sections 5.7 and 7.1)

window_flags.what: The harvest's per-attempt summary: flag counts by code, family and effect, and the hazard measurements taken at the arm.
window_flags.where: derived/window_flags.json in the attempt's harvest archive (registration section 5.7)

window_yield.what: The driver's count of what a window collected: members planned, bundles present, and a yield status.
window_yield.where: the yield block of night/hazard_result.json, the driver's terminal record (registration section 5.7)

flag.what: One flag: one recorded fact with its code, scope and observed values.
flag.where: derived/flags.jsonl in the attempt's harvest archive, one flag per line (registration section 0.16)

reference_bound_check.what: The harvest's structural check of the window's reference-drift bound, with the number of reference-corpus members collected.
reference_bound_check.where: derived/neg8-bound.json in the attempt's harvest archive (registration section 5.3)

meter.what: The whole-machine meter's record for one window: per member, the rail energy and the machine energy above idle, and their quotient.
meter.where: withheld/meter.json in the attempt's harvest archive (analysis plan section 8.2)

families.title: Design identity printed with the results
families.note: Design parameters, not results of block 5. Methods prose takes them from the registered-values table, not from a slot; the slots exist so that every row of analysis plan section 9 is covered.

families.title: Reported phase energy per model and phase
families.note: At the sync point the code fixes the kept-unit counts at their planned values; the amended estimator over kept units is the open REPORTED-ENERGY-ISSUER work.

families.title: Attribution floor printed beside each reported cell
families.note: Printed beside the cell and never added into its interval. Its value and its applicability to this OS build are an open binding.

families.title: Detection floors per model and phase
families.note: The artifact's cell id for each model and phase is fixed by the mint's input manifest, which is open; a slot therefore selects its cell by condition family.

families.title: Dominance ratios, the branch and what the branch licenses
families.note: Each ratio prints with its numerator and denominator in joules and the number of units of its floor component (the floor family's kept-unit slots). A ratio is a point diagnostic with no interval.

families.title: The two model contrasts and their verdicts
families.rung: L2 only if the claim gate's claim_ready_for_l2_l3 is true; otherwise L1 wording

families.title: Registered descriptive estimates beside each contrast
families.note: Computed by the disclosure producer, which does not exist yet; each slot names the existing field its registered formula starts from.

families.title: Disclosure: the units removed from each cell and contrast
families.note: The counts of kept units are slots of the reported, floor and contrast families.

families.title: Disclosure: the attempt history of each pack
families.note: One row per attempt of the pack, analysed or not.

families.title: Disclosure: every reported cell and contrast with and without battery-assisted members
families.note: The value with assisted members is the reported cell or contrast itself.

families.title: Disclosure (proposed): each cell and contrast without the physics-in-span exclusions
families.note: The seal gate adopts or strikes this line; if it is struck these slots are deleted.

families.title: Disclosure: agreement between the contrast window and each floor window
Disclosure: the decision interval against the floor, and the leave-one-quad-out concern
Disclosure: what the monitor and the harvest recorded about each analysed window
families.note: Counts and measured hazard quantities only. The energies that belong to the same disclosures are listed under unbound_lines.

families.title: Disclosure: the deliberate clock-step control
families.note: Runs once, at the tail of the first ALPHA window.

families.title: Whole-machine cross-check (descriptive, never a claim number)
families.note: Describes every collected member, kept or removed. Never refuses a window, removes a member or enters a claim.

unbound_lines.key: reference drift: screen result and drift allowance of each window
unbound_lines.why: The allowance is an energy read through a function that authenticates the harvest record (analysis plan section 4 step 4); the plan names no single field to print it from.

unbound_lines.key: reference drift: the bound's two terms at the realised reference counts
unbound_lines.why: Energies kept in restricted custody; the plan names no field.

unbound_lines.key: clock: members whose clock anchor is bounded, and the largest effective bound, per window
unbound_lines.why: No harvest record holds this count as one field at the sync point.

unbound_lines.key: contention: the host's total busy CPU during requests, per window
unbound_lines.why: The input field was not found in the harvest records at the sync point.

unbound_lines.key: battery: the discharged energies of assisted members
unbound_lines.why: Energies in withheld/battery-assist.json; the plan names the file, not a field.

unbound_lines.key: monitor cost: CPU time of the hazard monitor and of the meter reader, per window
unbound_lines.why: The input field was not found in the harvest records at the sync point.

unbound_lines.key: battery temperature: every stage's readings, rise and plateau
unbound_lines.why: The readings live in each stage's campaign manifest, which has no schema id in code; only the two flags are slots.

unbound_lines.key: clock-step control: the redraw cycles that followed it
unbound_lines.why: No record with a schema id holds the count.
